gates.says: all 3 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-first-year: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-first-year: Revenue requirement is depreciation plus return, and the rate base is 'net of accumulated depreciation'. Year 1: $100k depreciation; end-of-year net plant is $1,900k, and 10% of it is $190k, so $290k.
recorded.prompt:q-shares: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-shares: 'No program envelope was imposed here; each program's share is whatever maximizes total NPV under the yearly budgets and floors.'
recorded.prompt:q-how-much: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-how-much: 'the honest answer from the model is a set of plans, one per budget, and what each one buys; the budget itself is a business and regulatory decision.'

recorded.prompt:q-first-year:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-first-year:a: Reference table: 'revenue requirement | depreciation + return'. Depreciation is part of the requirement, so it cannot be left out.
recorded.prompt:q-first-year:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-first-year:c: The rate base is 'plant in service at original cost, less the depreciation already charged'. At the end of year 1 that is $1,900k, not $2,000k.
recorded.prompt:q-first-year:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-first-year:d: 'A capital dollar is recovered over the asset's life, and while it is not yet recovered the utility earns a return on it.'
recorded.prompt:q-shares:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-shares:a: Each share is whatever maximizes NPV. The funded fractions also differ: 26,720 of 43,990, 11,790 of 21,920, 3,120 of 3,900.
recorded.prompt:q-shares:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-shares:b: 'No program envelope was imposed here.' The optimizer never sets budgets.
recorded.prompt:q-shares:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-shares:c: 'the optimized plan funds 27 of 40 projects', and only 4 are must-do, so programs get more than their must-do cost.
recorded.prompt:q-how-much:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-how-much:b: Design Note: 'It is tempting to let the optimizer "find the right budget" by adding a budget variable... Resist it.'
recorded.prompt:q-how-much:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-how-much:c: 'The optimizer never sets the budget'. The answer is 'a set of plans, one per budget', not the must-do spend.
recorded.prompt:q-how-much:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-how-much:d: The answer is a set of plans, one per budget. Requests are 1.65 times the budgets: 'if every request fit, there would be nothing to choose.'
